bbs_invisible.config.title: Transparent background
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.title: Transparent background
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.tooltip: Remove the sky background; screenshots and videos keep an alpha channel
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.enabled: Removes sky, clouds and fog so the background becomes truly transparent (shown as a checkerboard in the preview). Screenshots are saved as PNG with alpha; videos are encoded with an alpha-capable codec (see the Transparent export category, requires FFmpeg).
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.film_on: On: the sky is only removed inside the BBS film panel (preview, screenshots, recording). Off: it is removed during normal gameplay too.
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.hide_cl: Used when there is no "Transparent background: clouds" curve: on = no clouds, off = keep clouds. Add the curve to fade them with keyframes
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.disable: Used when there is no "Transparent background: fog" curve: on = no fog, off = keep fog. Add the curve to fade it with keyframes
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.checker: Show a checkerboard instead of black behind the film panel preview so transparent areas are obvious
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.hide_te: Do not render terrain blocks; only entities, particles and BBS models remain. Affects exports, so turn it off when you are done
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.hide_bl: When terrain is hidden, also hide chests, signs, etc. (BBS model blocks are not affected)
bbs_invisible.config.export.title: Transparent export
bbs_invisible.config.export.tooltip: Video encoding used while the transparent background is enabled
bbs_invisible.config.export.format-comme: 0 = ProRes 4444 (.mov, readable by Premiere / After Effects / DaVinci, recommended); 1 = PNG sequence (name_00001.png ... in the movies folder, no audio); 2 = WebM VP9 with alpha; 3 = custom, use the arguments below. Only used while the transparent background is enabled; your regular Video recording arguments are left untouched.
bbs_invisible.config.export.arguments-co: FFmpeg arguments used when the format is 3. The input must be -pix_fmt bgra (4 channels) and the output codec must support alpha. Same placeholders as the BBS video settings: %WIDTH% %HEIGHT% %FPS% %FILTERS% %NAME% %AUDIO_TRACK%
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.amount-: Transparency used when there is no "Transparent background" curve: 1 = fully transparent, 0 = normal sky. Add the "Transparent background" key in a curve clip to animate it with keyframes (keep "Enable transparent background" on; it is the master switch for alpha export).
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.opaque_: Distant leaves and other cutout blocks become semi-transparent because of texture mipmapping. This forces opaque blocks to full alpha (water and glass are unaffected). Turn it off to compare if something looks wrong.
bbs_invisible.clip.title: Transparent Background
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.hide_en: Do not render entities (mobs, items, armor stands...). BBS actors are not affected. Curve value: 0 = visible, 1 = hidden, in between = fades
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.hide_pa: Do not render particles. Curve value: 0 = visible, 1 = hidden, in between = fades
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.hide_mo: Do not render BBS model blocks. Curve value: 0 = visible, 1 = hidden, in between = fades
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.use_fil: Filter entities by the IDs below. Curve value: 0 = visible, 1 = hidden, in between = fades
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.filter_: 0 = hide listed entities, 1 = show only listed entities
Entity IDs separated by commas or spaces, e.g. minecraft:zombie, creeper, mymod:* (namespace:* matches a whole mod)
bbs_invisible.config.transparent.shader_: With a shader pack on, uses the depth buffer to decide where the sky is and makes it transparent. Needs the depth to survive the shader pipeline; may produce a fully transparent frame, turn it off if so
